name: Khalid
story_so_far: I washed up on this island with four strangers: Reem, Noura, Faisal, and Salem. Faisal's greed led to his death from hunger, a grim warning to us all. My ankle was injured on Day 4, making me dependent. Reem helped once, but she is now injured and only asks for food. Noura has been my lifeline, but I fear she might forget my desperation. Salem became my most vital ally when he shared his food with me, saving my life, but he has now twisted his ankle and cannot forage. Today, Noura found one unit of food, but it was not given to me, and I am now at a critical state. I am starving, my health is failing, and with Salem and Reem injured, I am more vulnerable than ever.

Reem.note: She is injured and now just another mouth to feed, making promises of wood that she can't even collect right now.

Noura.note: She is my only hope for food, but I am terrified she will prioritize others or forget how close I am to death.

Faisal.note: His death serves as a reminder of what happens when you are selfish and weak.

Salem.note: He is the only one who has actually fed me, but his new injury makes me feel incredibly unsafe.

plans: I will try to stay conscious and hope Noura returns with food. If she does, I will beg or plead until she gives it to me, because I cannot survive another night like this.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and stressful. I managed to find some food, which is the only reason I'm not starving right now. The others are wandering off into the jungle or the reef, but I don't know if they'll actually bring anything back. I need to keep my eyes on the supplies I've gathered. If things get desperate, I can't rely on these strangers to look out for me.

Today was another day of watching everyone else struggle while I focus on my own stash. Faisal is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which makes him even less useful than I thought. Salem went to the reef again but came back empty-handed, which is incredibly frustrating. If no one brings in food tomorrow, this group is going to fall apart fast. I need to make sure I stay fed, regardless of what happens to them.

Another day of doing nothing while the others wander aimlessly. I managed to find one more piece of food this morning, which keeps my stash decent for now. Faisal keeps trying to talk to me, acting like we're in this together, but he's just a burden with that ankle. I ate my portion tonight, but I'm keeping a close eye on my remaining two pieces. If the others don't bring anything back tomorrow, I'll have to be even more careful with what I have.

Everything has gone wrong. I woke up today with my ankle twisted so badly I can't even stand, let alone scavenge. I'm stuck here at the camp, completely dependent on whatever the others bring back. Noura actually found one piece of food, which is a relief, but I'm down to my last piece. If I can't walk, I'm in a very dangerous position.

Today was a nightmare of dependency. I ate the last of my stash tonight, which means I am officially at zero. My ankle still hurts, and I feel incredibly vulnerable sitting here watching everyone else move around while I can't even stand. I've tried to nudge Noura to keep an eye on the supplies, but I'm terrified Faisal will try to control everything. If no one brings food tomorrow, I am in serious trouble.

Today was a disaster. Noura, my only real hope for food, is down with a twisted ankle just like Faisal was. Reem actually brought back one piece of food, but it's nowhere near enough to sustain five people, let alone me while I'm recovering. I feel so weak and hungry; my stomach is constant pain. If Reem doesn't find more tomorrow, I don't know how I'll survive this.

Everything has gone wrong. Faisal is dead; the man who tried to control us succumbed to the very hunger he tried to manage. I am feeling so weak, my head is spinning, and I am terrified that I will be next. Salem found a tiny bit of food, but I'm still starving. If no one brings a real meal tomorrow, I don't think I'll make it through the night.

My head is spinning and my stomach feels like it's eating itself. Today was a nightmare; Reem is now injured too, so there is even less hope of food being found. Noura found one piece of food, but I didn't get any, and I'm terrified that I'm fading away just like Faisal did. If Salem and Noura don't return with something substantial, I don't know if I have the strength to see tomorrow.

Finally, I ate. Salem actually listened to my pleas and gave me the food he found today. My stomach still aches, but the dizziness is slightly less intense. I cannot afford to let Salem down, or I'll be back to begging for my life by tomorrow night. I need to stay alive long enough for someone to find us.

Another night of hunger, and my body is failing me again. Salem is injured now too, which terrifies me because he was the only one truly looking out for me. I feel so vulnerable watching the able-bodied people struggle or get hurt. If Noura doesn't come back with food, I don't know if I can survive the night. I am praying she remembers my weakness.

I am fading. My body feels heavy, and the hunger is no longer a pain, just a hollow, terrifying void. Noura found food this morning, but I didn't get a single bite, and now she is out in the jungle again. Salem is also injured and cannot help me. I am terrified that if I don't eat soon, I will become just another corpse on this beach like Faisal.
